newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Rim proposes warrant issue.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Rim proposes warrant issue.

text.p: Pacific Rim Infrastructure Management Enterprises Ltd said on Friday it was planning to make a private placement of 406 million warrants at HK$0.25 per warrant to raise additional working capital.
The company expected to raise HK$97.0 million after expenses, it said in a statement.
The warrants will entitle holders to subscribe for Pacific Rim shares at HK$0.75 a share during the 18 months after the issue of the warrants, a company statement said.
The pricing of the warrants represents a premium of about 11.1 percent to the ordinary share's closing price of HK$0.90 on Thursday.

If the subscription rights attached to the warrants are fully exercised, a total of 406 million shares, or less than 20 percent of the issued share capital of the company, would be issued, the company said.
Pacific Rim, a construction and engineering firm formerly named CEF Concord Holdings Ltd, carried out a series of asset acquisitions and fund-raising measures in December 1996.
